original_value: In recent years strokes are one of the leading causes of death by affecting the central nervous system. Among different types of strokes, ischemic and hemorrhagic majorly damages the central nervous system. According to the World Health Organization (WHO), globally 3% of the population are affected by subarachnoid hemorrhage, 10% with intracerebral hemorrhage, and the majority of 87% with ischemic stroke. In this research work, Machine Learning techniques are applied in identifying, classifying, and predicting the stroke from medical information. The existing research is limited in predicting risk factors pertained to various types of strokes. To address this limitation a Stroke Prediction (SPN) algorithm is proposed by using the improvised random forest in analyzing the levels of risks obtained within the strokes. This research of the Stroke Predictor (SPR) model using machine learning techniques improved the prediction accuracy to 96.97% when compared with the existing models.

result.paraphrase: In recent years, strokes have become one of the leading causes of death by affecting the central nervous system. Of the various stroke types, ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes cause the greatest damage to the central nervous system. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that, worldwide, 3% of the population is affected by subarachnoid hemorrhage, 10% by intracerebral hemorrhage, and the remaining 87% by ischemic stroke. In this study, machine learning techniques are used to identify, classify, and predict stroke from medical data. Existing research is limited in predicting risk factors associated with different stroke types. To overcome this limitation, a Stroke Prediction (SPN) algorithm is proposed using an improved random forest to analyze risk levels within strokes. This Stroke Predictor (SPR) model, based on machine learning techniques, improved prediction accuracy to 96.97% compared with existing models.
